rest = (int32)(header[0] & 0x3fffffff) - (int32)need; when rest > 0x27 carve: header[0] = (header[0] & 0xc0000000) | (need & 0x3fffffff); tail = header + (header[0] & 0x3fffffff); tail[0] = rest; tail[1] = header
if freelist_0c == cursor then freelist_0c = header + (header[0] & 0x3fffffff)
when 0x40000000 is clear, return aligned immediately
otherwise header[0] |= 0x40000000 and *(void**)(aligned - 0x0c + (header[0] & 0x3fffffff)) = self, then return aligned
